llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了水凝胶在纳米粘土悬浮液中的可打印性，未涉及人工智能方法。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate AI or machine learning into any stage of the bioprinting workflow; it focuses solely on experimental rheology and printability.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究水凝胶在纳米粘土浴中的挤出可打印性。
summary_zh.method: 通过挤出打印实验测试不同参数的影响。
summary_zh.result: 确定了打印窗口和凝胶化条件的关键因素。
summary_zh.validation: 通过打印实验和流变测试验证可打印性。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the printability of hydrogel solutions extruded into a nanoclay yield-stress bath for printing-then-gelation biofabrication.
summary_en.method: Extrusion-based printing experiments were conducted with varying parameters to assess printability.
summary_en.result: Key factors influencing print fidelity and gelation were identified, enabling fabrication of complex structures.
summary_en.validation: The study experimentally validated printability through rheological measurements and printing tests.

papers.title: Investigation of the Selective Laser Melting process with tungsten metal powder
papers.abstract: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) is a leading Additive Manufacturing (AM) technology used for high value low volume manufacturing. It is currently used commercially for processing of steels, titanium, nickel- and aluminum-alloys in medical and aerospace industries. It is not used currently for refractory metals, mainly because of the intrinsic problems of processing higher melting point materials but also due to the process being driven slowly by the industries involved. Successful SLM processing requires development of material specific processing parameters that differ between materials and so the system must be developed to match each material used. In this study, processing of tungsten is considered for the production of solid and porous parts. The study also considers the role of the pure tungsten powder interaction with processing conditions within SLM. The process quality is quantified in terms of porosity, integrity and microstructure. The reasons why the parameters used have the effects observed is discussed and the effects on future development of this technology in this field is discussed.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究钨粉末的选择性激光熔化工艺，与生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no stress shielding analysis, no mechanical testing (fatigue or compression), no surface roughness or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究钨金属粉末的选择性激光熔化工艺参数影响。
summary_zh.method: 改变SLM工艺参数制备实心和多孔钨样品。
summary_zh.result: 分析了工艺参数对孔隙率、完整性和微观结构的影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过孔隙率和微观结构表征验证工艺质量。

summary_en.motivation: To develop processing parameters for selective laser melting of tungsten metal powder for solid and porous parts.
summary_en.method: Systematic variation of SLM parameters and characterization of porosity and microstructure.
summary_en.result: Process parameters significantly affect part porosity, integrity, and microstructure.
